dataset: Prior course energy-data.csv, selected three-country business electricity rows
basis: Business retail electricity benchmark at 1,000,000 kWh per year; includes supply, transmission, distribution, taxes and fees. Archived course snapshot, not a 12 MW data-center quote.
colocation_note: Market screening proxies only: Phoenix and London CBRE Q1 2025 asking rents are for 250–500 kW deployments; the China Post July 2025 figure is a public procurement ceiling for 5/20 kW cabinets. Different deal sizes and service bundles; do not treat as comparable 10 MW offers or add electricity unless contract terms exclude power.

rows.colo_basis: CBRE Q1 2025 average asking rent; 250–500 kW market series
July 2025 ceiling: ¥38,500/year per 5 kW cabinet; not an average
Midpoint of CBRE Q1 2025 $180–215/kW-month range; 250–500 kW series
